# einvoicecost.ae

> UAE e-invoicing cost calculator and done-for-you setup. Shows the exact price upfront for your software and your exact invoice count, with no slabs or brackets. Most providers only quote after a sales call. Prices updated: 9 November 2026. Prices in AED, excluding 5% VAT.

## Key facts
- UAE businesses under AED 50 million revenue must appoint an Accredited Service Provider (ASP) by 31 March 2027 and go live with e-invoicing on 1 July 2027.
- Fine for appointing an ASP late: AED 5,000 a month. After go-live, each invoice not issued electronically can be fined AED 100, up to AED 5,000 a month.
- QuickBooks (Online and Desktop) and Excel are not ASPs, so they need an outside ASP and a connection. einvoicecost.ae handles the full setup.
- Zoho Books, TallyPrime and Wafeq are ASPs themselves (built-in e-invoicing).
- B2C sales are outside the UAE e-invoicing system.

## Prices (first year for up to 500 invoices, then AED 500 a year)
- QuickBooks Online: AED 4,500 first year (ASP registration 1,000 + setup 3,000 + e-invoicing 500)
- QuickBooks Desktop: AED 5,500 first year (1,000 + 4,000 + 500)
- Excel / no software: AED 3,500 first year (1,000 + 2,000 + 500)
- Above 500 invoices: you pay for your exact number of invoices, no slabs or brackets. Supplier invoices you receive are not counted.
- Zoho Books, Tally, Wafeq: e-invoicing built in; optional done-for-you setup AED 1,500.
- Other software (Xero, Odoo, Sage, SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, ERPNext, BUSY and more): price on WhatsApp.
